locator.text: Equation (5.18), p. 52, in the proof of Lemma 5.2

evidence: paper: E_n = U_n = F_n = V_n = 0 \quad \text{on the reserved mean patch } \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{mean}},\ \text{for every } n \ge 1

provenance.note: machine audit, checked by a second agent; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Lean states E_n = U_n = 0 on a region containing the mean patch, but states F_n = 0 and V_n = 0 only beyond a radius that lies outside every reserved patch.
